title: Tanist
html_source: The heir apparent to an ancient Celtic chief, elected during the chief’s lifetime.

anchor.prefix: purned lover. I was a strapping young gossoon at that time, I tell you. I'll show you my likeness one day. I was, faith. Lover, for her love he prowled with colonel Richard Burke,
anchor.suffix: of his sept, under the walls of Clerkenwell and, crouching, saw a flame of vengeance hurl them upward in the fog. Shattered glass and toppling masonry. In gay Paree he hides, Egan
